Chapter 14

Pod SchedulingPod 调度

The scheduler is the cluster component responsible for deciding which node to select for running a Pod. In this chapter, you will learn about the general scheduling algorithm and the Kubernetes concepts that let you express soft and hard requirements for influencing the scheduling decisions.

调度器是负责决定选择哪个节点来运行 Pod 的集群组件。本章你将了解通用调度算法，以及让你能够表达软、硬需求以影响调度决策的 Kubernetes 概念。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖范围

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objective: - Configure Pod admission and scheduling (limits, node affinity, etc.)

本章对应以下考试大纲目标： - 配置 Pod 准入与调度（限制、节点亲和性等）

Pod Scheduling AlgorithmPod 调度算法

Initially a Pod created by an end user does not have a node assigned. That's the job of the scheduler cluster component. The scheduler runs in a scheduling loop, watching for unscheduled Pods. It will then evaluate available nodes to choose the most suitable one for the Pod.

最初，终端用户创建的 Pod 并没有被分配节点。这正是调度器集群组件的工作。调度器运行在一个调度循环中，监视未调度的 Pod。然后它会评估可用节点，为该 Pod 选择最合适的一个。

Finding a fitting node follows a two-step approach: filtering and scoring. The filtering step determines the list of nodes feasible for running a Pod (e.g., by checking the available hardware capacity). The scoring step ranks the remaining nodes to select the most suitable to run the workload. Scheduling decisions include resource requirements, affinity and anti-affinity specifications, and many more. You can find a visualization of the Pod scheduling algorithm in Figure 14-1.

寻找合适节点遵循两步法：过滤和打分。过滤步骤确定可运行 Pod 的节点列表（例如通过检查可用硬件容量）。打分步骤对剩余节点排序，选出最适合运行该工作负载的节点。调度决策包括资源需求、亲和性与反亲和性规则等。你可以在图 14-1 中找到 Pod 调度算法的可视化。

— PDF p.203 —

Pods and their container(s) can define requirements that help with determining the node. If the requirements cannot be met by any of the nodes, then the Pod stays unscheduled until the scheduler checks again. Otherwise, the scheduler picks the node with the highest score and assigns the Pod to it.

Pod 及其容器可以定义帮助确定节点的需求。如果所有节点都无法满足这些需求，该 Pod 就会保持未调度状态，直到调度器再次检查。否则，调度器选择得分最高的节点，并把 Pod 分配给它。

Setting Up a Multi-Node Development Cluster搭建多节点开发集群

The effects of scheduling requirements are best explained by demonstrating them on a multi-node cluster. For the remainder of this chapter, I am going to use a cluster with one control plane node and three worker nodes, as shown here:

调度需求的效果最好通过在多节点集群上演示来说明。本章剩余部分，我将使用一个拥有一个控制平面节点和三个工作节点的集群，如下所示：

$ kubectl get nodes
NAME             STATUS   ROLES           AGE     VERSION
multi-node       Ready    control-plane   2m33s   v1.32.2
multi-node-m02   Ready    <none>          2m22s   v1.32.2
multi-node-m03   Ready    <none>          2m15s   v1.32.2
multi-node-m04   Ready    <none>          2m9s    v1.32.2

Setting up a multi-node cluster with a Kubernetes environment is pretty easy to achieve. Most development cluster implementations like minikube and kind offer an option to initiate more than a single node. The following command creates a four-node cluster with the name prefix multi-node using minikube:

搭建一个带 Kubernetes 环境的多节点集群相当容易实现。大多数开发集群实现（如 minikube 和 kind）都提供了启动多节点的选项。以下命令使用 minikube 创建一个名称前缀为 multi-node 的四节点集群：

$ minikube start --kubernetes-version=v1.32.2 --nodes=4 -p multi-node

Refer to the documentation of the Kubernetes development cluster of your choice for more information on applicable configuration options.

关于适用配置选项的更多信息，请查阅你所选 Kubernetes 开发集群的文档。

Determining the Node a Pod Runs On确定 Pod 运行在哪个节点上

The prerequisite for being able to schedule a Pod is that the scheduler is functional. The scheduler process runs in a Pod on the control plane node. You can use the following command to find the scheduler Pod. Make sure that the Pod has the Running status:

能够调度 Pod 的前提是调度器正常工作。调度器进程运行在控制平面节点上的一个 Pod 中。你可以用以下命令找到调度器 Pod。请确认该 Pod 处于 Running 状态：

$ kubectl get pods -n kube-system
NAME                        READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
kube-scheduler-multi-node   1/1     Running   0          5m10s

You can find out which node a Pod runs with the kubectl get or kubectl describe command. The following commands show variations of their usage for a Pod named nginx:

你可以用 kubectl get 或 kubectl describe 命令查明 Pod 运行在哪个节点上。以下命令展示了对名为 nginx 的 Pod 的不同用法：

$ kubectl get pod nginx -o=wide
NAME    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE     IP           NODE             ...
nginx   1/1     Running   0          3m49s   10.244.2.2   multi-node-m03   ...
$ kubectl get pod nginx -o yaml | grep nodeName:
      nodeName: multi-node-m03
$ kubectl describe pod nginx
Name:             nginx
Namespace:        default
Priority:         0
Service Account:  default
Node:             multi-node-m03/192.168.49.4
...

Pod Scheduling OptionsPod 调度选项

The scheduler does a reasonably good job of assigning a Pod to a feasible node. Under certain conditions, you may want to restrict which node a Pod can run on, or define a preferred selection criteria. This is usually expressed by using label selection. Kubernetes offers a variety of Pod scheduling options, each of which can be combined with one another. In this chapter, I am going to discuss the following concepts, however, there are more you can select from:

调度器在把 Pod 分配到可行节点方面做得相当不错。在某些条件下，你可能想限制 Pod 可以运行在哪个节点上，或定义偏好的选择标准。这通常通过标签选择器表达。Kubernetes 提供了多种 Pod 调度选项，每一种都可以互相组合。本章我将讨论以下概念，但你还可以选择更多：

  • Node selector: A hard requirement to determine which node the Pod needs to run onNode selector（节点选择器）：用于确定 Pod 需要运行在哪个节点上的硬性需求
  • Node affinity and anti-affinity: A more flexible requirement for defining hard or soft requirements for node selection节点亲和性与反亲和性：一种更灵活的需求，用于为节点选择定义硬性或软性需求
  • Taints and tolerations: A way to safeguard specific nodes from scheduling Pods on them based on conditions and requirements污点与容忍：一种根据条件和需求，保护特定节点不被调度 Pod 的方式
— PDF p.205 —
  • Pod topology spread constraints: Defines how to spread Pods across different topologies, i.e., regions and zonesPod 拓扑分布约束：定义如何把 Pod 分布到不同拓扑（即区域和可用区）

Working with Node Selectors使用 Node Selector

The node selector defines a hard requirement for scheduling a Pod on specific nodes. To use the node selector, label one or many nodes with a specific label key-value pair. When defining a Pod in a YAML manifest, select the label from the Pod via the attribute spec.nodeSelector.

node selector 为把 Pod 调度到特定节点定义了硬性需求。要使用 node selector，先给一个或多个节点打上特定的标签键值对。在 YAML 清单中定义 Pod 时，通过 spec.nodeSelector 属性从 Pod 中选择该标签。

A typical example for using the node selector is to ensure that Pods end up running on a node with specific hardware. Input/output-intensive applications that require fast disk access, e.g., as supported by solid-state drive (SSD) volumes, could make good use of this concept.

使用 node selector 的一个典型例子是确保 Pod 最终运行在具有特定硬件的节点上。需要快速磁盘访问的 I/O 密集型应用（例如由固态硬盘（SSD）卷支持的访问）可以很好地利用这一概念。

Figure 14-2 illustrates a cluster with three nodes. Node 1 has the label disk=ssd and Node 2 has the label disk=hdd. Pod 1 can only be scheduled on Node 1, as it defines the matching node selector, and therefore on none of the other nodes. Pod 2 cannot be scheduled on any of the nodes, as the node selector doesn't match any of the nodes' labels. Pod 1 and Pod 2 cannot be scheduled on Node 3.

图 14-2 展示了一个含三个节点的集群。节点 1 带有标签 disk=ssd，节点 2 带有标签 disk=hdd。Pod 1 只能被调度到节点 1，因为它定义了匹配的 node selector，因此不能调度到其他任何节点。Pod 2 无法被调度到任何节点，因为其 node selector 不匹配任何节点的标签。Pod 1 和 Pod 2 都不能调度到节点 3。

Labeling a Node给节点打标签

Following the described use case of running applications only on nodes that provide SSD volume access, we'll first need to assign a specific label key-value pair. The following command uses the imperative kubectl label command to assign the label disk=ssd to the node named multi-node-m03:

按照前面描述的、只在提供 SSD 卷访问的节点上运行应用的用例，我们首先需要分配一个特定的标签键值对。以下命令使用命令式 kubectl label 命令，把标签 disk=ssd 分配给名为 multi-node-m03 的节点：

$ kubectl label node multi-node-m03 disk=ssd
node/multi-node-m03 labeled
— PDF p.206 —

You can find the assigned labels for all nodes when listing them with the --show-labels option:

用 --show-labels 选项列出所有节点时，可以看到它们被分配的标签：

$ kubectl get nodes --show-labels
NAME             STATUS   ROLES           AGE   VERSION   LABELS
multi-node       Ready    control-plane   14m   v1.32.2   ...
multi-node-m02   Ready    <none>          14m   v1.32.2   ...
multi-node-m03   Ready    <none>          14m   v1.32.2   ...
multi-node-m04   Ready    <none>          14m   v1.32.2   ...,disk=ssd,...

Next up, you will need to select this label from the Pod that should be scheduled on the node multi-node-m03.

接下来，你需要从那个应当被调度到节点 multi-node-m03 的 Pod 中选择这个标签。

Assigning a Node Selector to a Pod为 Pod 分配 Node Selector

The only addition to the typical structure is the definition of the spec.nodeSelector attribute, as shown in Example 14-1.

对典型结构的唯一补充是 spec.nodeSelector 属性的定义，如示例 14-1 所示。

Example 14-1. Assigning a node selector

示例 14-1. 分配 node selector

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    disk: ssd
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:1.27.1
  • Defines a node selector for the Pod为 Pod 定义 node selector
  • The label key-value pair used to determine a suitable node用于确定合适节点的标签键值对
Node selector limitationsNode selector 的局限

The node selector is not limited to a single label key-value pair. Selecting a map of labels is completely valid.

node selector 并不局限于单个标签键值对。选择一个标签映射（map）也是完全有效的。

The Pod with this definition can only be scheduled on the node that provides the matching label. You can verify that the Pod runs on the expected node with the same command described in "Determining the Node a Pod Runs On" on page 183.

具有此定义的 Pod 只能被调度到提供匹配标签的节点上。你可以用第 183 页"Determining the Node a Pod Runs On"中描述的同一命令，验证 Pod 是否运行在预期节点上。

— PDF p.207 —

Working with Node Affinity and Anti-Affinity使用节点亲和性与反亲和性

In Kubernetes, the spec.nodeSelector field is used to define strict scheduling constraints—it allows you to specify hard requirements that a node must satisfy for a Pod to be scheduled on it. While simple and straightforward, the node selector is limited to exact key-value label matches and does not support advanced logic.

在 Kubernetes 中，spec.nodeSelector 字段用于定义严格的调度约束——它让你能够指定节点必须满足的硬性需求，Pod 才能被调度到该节点上。node selector 虽然简单直接，但仅限于精确的键值标签匹配，不支持高级逻辑。

For more flexible and expressive scheduling rules, you should use node affinity, defined under spec.affinity.nodeAffinity in the Pod specification. Node affinity allows you to match nodes using label selector expressions, enabling more complex criteria such as logical operators (In, NotIn, Exists, etc.) and prioritized preferences.

要使用更灵活、更具表达力的调度规则，你应当使用节点亲和性，它在 Pod 规格中的 spec.affinity.nodeAffinity 下定义。节点亲和性让你能用标签选择表达式匹配节点，从而支持更复杂的条件，例如逻辑运算符（In、NotIn、Exists 等）和带优先级的偏好。

Coming back to the previous use case, you may want to run Pods on nodes that support SSD-based volumes or volumes with slower storage devices if the primary preference cannot be fulfilled.

回到前面的用例，如果首选偏好无法满足，你可能想把 Pod 运行在支持基于 SSD 卷的节点上，或使用较慢存储设备的卷的节点上。

Figure 14-3 shows the node affinity concept in action. In this scenario, Pod 1 can be scheduled on Node 1 or Node 2 based on the defined set-based label selection.

图 14-3 展示了节点亲和性概念的实际效果。在该场景中，基于定义的集合式标签选择，Pod 1 可以被调度到节点 1 或节点 2。

Node anti-affinity is useful in situations where you want to prevent Pods from being scheduled on specific nodes. This is particularly helpful in high-availability situations where you want to spread Pods across different zones or regions.

节点反亲和性在你想阻止 Pod 被调度到特定节点时很有用。这在高可用场景中尤其有帮助——你想把 Pod 分布到不同可用区或区域。

Assigning a Node Affinity to a Pod为 Pod 分配节点亲和性

In short, node affinity effectively replaces the node selector for most use cases, offering greater precision and control over workload placement. Example 14-2 shows the same Pod definition we saw earlier, but in this case it allows for placing the Pod on a node where the assigned label key-value pair is disk=ssd or disk=hdd.

简而言之，节点亲和性在大多数用例中实际上替代了 node selector，对工作负载放置提供了更高的精确度和控制力。示例 14-2 展示了我们之前看到的同一个 Pod 定义，但这次它允许把 Pod 放置到标签键值对为 disk=ssd 或 disk=hdd 的节点上。

— PDF p.208 —

Example 14-2. Assigning node affinity

示例 14-2. 分配节点亲和性

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - key: disk
            operator: In
            values:
            - ssd
            - hdd
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:1.27.1
  • Defines a node affinity for the Pod为 Pod 定义节点亲和性
  • The node affinity type that will be adhered to when scheduling the Pod调度 Pod 时将遵循的节点亲和性类型
  • The expression for finding matching nodes用于查找匹配节点的表达式
  • A set-based label requirement一个集合式标签需求

Node Affinity Types节点亲和性类型

Beyond supporting set-based expressions, node affinity also introduces specific types that control when the rules are applied. One commonly used type is requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution. This setting means that the affinity rules are strictly enforced only at the time of scheduling—when the Pod is initially assigned to a node. Once the Pod is running, any changes to the node affinity rules are ignored and will not trigger rescheduling.

除了支持集合式表达式，节点亲和性还引入了特定类型来控制规则何时应用。一种常用类型是 requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution。该设置意味着亲和性规则只在调度时——即 Pod 最初被分配到节点时——被严格执行。一旦 Pod 运行起来，对节点亲和性规则的任何更改都会被忽略，不会触发重新调度。

This isn't the only available node affinity type. Table 14-1 shows the list. Types starting with requiredDuringScheduling express a hard requirement, and types starting with preferredDuringScheduling express a soft requirement, a preference which the schedule doesn't have to adhere to in case no fitting node can be determined.

这并不是唯一可用的节点亲和性类型。表 14-1 列出了全部类型。以 requiredDuringScheduling 开头的类型表达硬性需求，以 preferredDuringScheduling 开头的类型表达软性需求——一种调度器在找不到合适节点时不必遵守的偏好。

— PDF p.209 —

Table 14-1. Node affinity types

表 14-1. 节点亲和性类型

TypeDescription
requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecutionRules that must be met for a Pod to be scheduled onto a node
requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecutionPod 要被调度到节点上所必须满足的规则
preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecutionRules that specify preferences that the scheduler will try to enforce but will not guarantee
preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution指定偏好的规则，调度器会尽量执行但不保证

At the time of writing, none of the node affinity types support modifying an already scheduled Pod, as indicated by the IgnoredDuringExecution suffix. The Kubernetes team may decide to change that in a future release.

写作本书时，没有任何节点亲和性类型支持修改已调度的 Pod，正如 IgnoredDuringExecution 后缀所表明的那样。Kubernetes 团队可能会在未来版本中改变这一点。

Node Affinity Operators节点亲和性运算符

In the previous example, you saw one of the node affinity operators in action: the In operator. The In operator is an operator that defines a requirement to find a label value as part of a given set of strings. You can select other operators to define node affinity requirements, as listed in Table 14-2.

在前面的例子中，你看到了一个节点亲和性运算符的实际效果：In 运算符。In 运算符定义了一种需求：在给定字符串集合中查找某个标签值。你可以选择其他运算符来定义节点亲和性需求，如表 14-2 所列。

Table 14-2. Node affinity operators

表 14-2. 节点亲和性运算符

OperatorBehavior
InA node has an assigned label value in the given set of strings.
In节点在给定字符串集合中具有某个被分配的标签值。
NotInOnly those nodes are selected that do not have an assigned label value in the given set of strings.
NotIn只选中那些在给定字符串集合中不具有被分配标签值的节点。
ExistsA node has a label key assigned to it that matches the given string.
Exists节点上分配了一个与给定字符串匹配的标签键。
DoesNotExistA node does not have a label key assigned to it that matches the given string.
DoesNotExist节点上没有分配与给定字符串匹配的标签键。
GtSelects nodes where the label's value is numerically greater than the specified value, like selecting nodes with more than 8 CPUs using "cpu-count Gt 8."
Gt选中标签值在数值上大于指定值的节点，例如用 "cpu-count Gt 8" 选择 CPU 超过 8 个的节点。
LtSelects nodes where the label's value is numerically less than the specified value, like selecting nodes with less than 16 GB memory using "memory-gb Lt 16."
Lt选中标签值在数值上小于指定值的节点，例如用 "memory-gb Lt 16" 选择内存小于 16 GB 的节点。

There are two operators, NotIn and DoesNotExist, that negate the selective effects of their counterparts In and Exists. Those operators are used to define a node anti-affinity behavior.

有两个运算符——NotIn 和 DoesNotExist——会否定其对应运算符 In 和 Exists 的选择效果。这些运算符用于定义节点反亲和性行为。

Assigning a Node Anti-Affinity to a Pod为 Pod 分配节点反亲和性

Node anti-affinity rules are typically used to prevent certain Pods from being scheduled on the same nodes, based on labels. An essential tool for defining anti-affinity behavior is the operator. Example 14-3 uses the NotIn operator to repel Pods from a set of nodes with the given label values.

节点反亲和性规则通常用于基于标签，阻止某些 Pod 被调度到相同节点上。定义反亲和性行为的一个关键工具是运算符。示例 14-3 使用 NotIn 运算符，把 Pod 从带有给定标签值的一组节点上排斥开。

— PDF p.210 —

Example 14-3. Assigning node anti-affinity

示例 14-3. 分配节点反亲和性

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - key: disk
            operator: NotIn
            values:
            - ssd
            - ebs
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:1.27.1
  • Defines a node anti-affinity by way of using a negating condition通过使用否定条件来定义节点反亲和性

In essence, node anti-affinity does not require you to learn a new API or new attributes when defining a Pod. Its usage primary boils down to the operator you select to define the node affinity rule.

本质上，定义节点反亲和性并不要求你在定义 Pod 时学习新的 API 或新属性。它的用法主要归结为你选择哪个运算符来定义节点亲和性规则。

Working with Taints and Tolerations使用污点与容忍

Similar to node anti-affinity, taints and tolerations represent another way in Kubernetes to influence where Pods can be scheduled, but they serve different purposes and work in fundamentally different ways. Node anti-affinity is meant to be used to spread or separate workload across nodes, whereas taints and tolerations are used for node isolation and workload protection.

与节点反亲和性类似，污点和容忍代表 Kubernetes 中影响 Pod 可被调度位置的另一种方式，但它们服务于不同目的，工作机制也根本不同。节点反亲和性用于在节点间分散或隔离工作负载，而污点和容忍用于节点隔离和工作负载保护。

The main purpose of taints and tolerations is to prevent Pods from being scheduled on a node unless they explicitly tolerate that node's taint. You'd add the taint to a node to say, "don't schedule anything here unless it tolerates the taint." Then in the Pod, you'd add a toleration if you want it to become schedulable on the tainted node.

污点和容忍的主要目的是阻止 Pod 被调度到某个节点上，除非它们显式容忍该节点的污点。你给节点加上污点，相当于说："除非能容忍这个污点，否则不要在这里调度任何东西。"然后在 Pod 中，如果你想让它能被调度到被打污点的节点上，就给它加一个容忍。

A typical use case for using taints and tolerations is the need to ensure that Pods are not scheduled on control plane nodes. Control plane nodes use the taint node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane:NoSchedule to prevent Pods from being scheduled on them unless they provide a corresponding toleration.

使用污点和容忍的一个典型用例是需要确保 Pod 不被调度到控制平面节点上。控制平面节点使用污点 node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane:NoSchedule 来阻止 Pod 被调度到其上，除非 Pod 提供相应的容忍。

In Figure 14-4, you can see a scenario that demonstrates the use of taints and tolerations. Node 1 and Node 3 tolerate Pod 1 and Pod 2. Node 2 accepts Pod 1, as it

在图 14-4 中，你可以看到一个演示污点和容忍用法的场景。节点 1 和节点 3 容忍 Pod 1 和 Pod 2。节点 2 接受 Pod 1，因为它

— PDF p.211 —

provides the matching toleration, but can also be scheduled on Node 1 and Node 3, as they do not define a taint.

提供了匹配的容忍，但 Pod 1 也可以被调度到节点 1 和节点 3 上，因为它们没有定义污点。

Let's demonstrate the process of adding a taint to a node and a toleration to a Pod by example.

我们通过示例演示给节点加污点、给 Pod 加容忍的过程。

Tainting a Node给节点打污点

A taint on a node marks it as unsuitable for certain Pods unless those Pods explicitly state they can tolerate it. A taint consists of three parts—key, value, and effect—formatted as key=value:effect. The key and value portions represent a simple, free-form key-value pair, similar to a label assignment. The effect describes the runtime treatment of the taint by the scheduler.

节点上的污点会把它标记为不适合某些 Pod，除非这些 Pod 显式声明能容忍它。一个污点由三部分组成——key、value 和 effect——格式为 key=value:effect。key 和 value 部分代表一个简单的、自由格式的键值对，类似于标签分配。effect 描述调度器在运行时对该污点的处理方式。

Use the imperative kubectl taint command to add a taint to a node. The following command adds the taint special=true:NoSchedule to the node named multi-node-m02:

使用命令式 kubectl taint 命令给节点添加污点。以下命令给名为 multi-node-m02 的节点添加污点 special=true:NoSchedule：

$ kubectl taint node multi-node-m02 special=true:NoSchedule
node/multi-node-m02 tainted

The scheduler now considers this taint during Pod placement. To view the assigned taints of a node, run the kubectl get or kubectl describe command. The following command renders the YAML representation of the node multi-node-m02 and then finds the relevant information in the output by combining it with the Linux grep command:

调度器现在在放置 Pod 时会考虑这个污点。要查看节点被分配的污点，运行 kubectl get 或 kubectl describe 命令。以下命令输出节点 multi-node-m02 的 YAML 表示，然后结合 Linux grep 命令在输出中查找相关信息：

$ kubectl get node multi-node-m02 -o yaml | grep -C 3 taints:
...
spec:
  taints:
  - effect: NoSchedule
— PDF p.212 —
    key: special
    value: "true"

Taint Effects污点效果

The taint shown in the previous example used the NoSchedule effect, which is a hard block for any Pod that doesn't come with the relevant toleration. You can choose from other taint effects, explained in Table 14-3.

前面例子中展示的污点使用了 NoSchedule 效果，它对任何未携带相关容忍的 Pod 都是硬性阻止。你还可以选择其他污点效果，如表 14-3 所述。

Table 14-3. Taint effects

表 14-3. 污点效果

EffectDescription
NoScheduleUnless a Pod has matching toleration, it won't be scheduled on the node.
NoSchedule除非 Pod 有匹配的容忍，否则不会被调度到该节点。
PreferNoScheduleTry not to place a Pod that does not tolerate the taint on the node, but it is not required.
PreferNoSchedule尽量不把不能容忍该污点的 Pod 放置到该节点，但并非强制。
NoExecuteEvict Pod from node if already running on it. No future scheduling on the node.
NoExecute如果 Pod 已经在节点上运行，则将其驱逐。今后不再向该节点调度。

In short, you can think of the available taint effects and their runtime enforcement in the following way. The effect NoSchedule is a hard block. PreferNoSchedule offers a soft suggestion. Lastly, NoExecute not only blocks Pods without the corresponding toleration but also evicts already running Pods that can't fulfill the requirement.

简而言之，你可以这样理解可用的污点效果及其运行时强制方式：NoSchedule 是硬性阻止；PreferNoSchedule 提供软性建议；最后，NoExecute 不仅阻止没有相应容忍的 Pod，还会驱逐已在运行但无法满足要求的 Pod。

Assigning a Toleration to a Pod为 Pod 分配容忍

To enable a Pod to run on a tainted node, you must add a toleration to the Pod specification that precisely matches the key, value, and effect of the node's taint. This tells the scheduler that the Pod is allowed to tolerate the taint and may be placed on the node despite the restriction.

要让 Pod 能在被打污点的节点上运行，你必须在 Pod 规格中添加一个与该节点污点的 key、value、effect 精确匹配的容忍。这告诉调度器：该 Pod 被允许容忍此污点，尽管有限制，也可以被放置到该节点上。

Example 14-4 shows a matching toleration assigned to a Pod for the taint special=true:NoSchedule.

示例 14-4 展示了为污点 special=true:NoSchedule 而分配给 Pod 的匹配容忍。

Example 14-4. Assigning a toleration

示例 14-4. 分配容忍

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: "special"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "true"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:1.27.1
— PDF p.213 —
  • The attribute that lets you define one or more tolerations.让你定义一个或多个容忍的属性。
  • The key of the toleration that needs to match the taint.需要与污点匹配的容忍的 key。
  • A toleration "matches" a taint if the keys are the same and the effects are the same.如果 key 相同且 effect 相同，则容忍与污点"匹配"。
  • The value of the toleration that needs to match the taint.需要与污点匹配的容忍的 value。
  • The runtime effect.运行时效果。

The usage of the effect in a toleration is required in most practical cases. If your toleration is missing the effect, it won't match any taint. Leaving off the effect is considered optional only when the operator Exists is used and you want to tolerate all taints with a specific key (regardless of value). Nevertheless, even in this scenario, specifying the effect is recommended.

在大多数实际情况下，容忍中 effect 的使用是必需的。如果你的容忍缺少 effect，它将不匹配任何污点。只有在使用运算符 Exists、且你想容忍具有特定 key（无论 value）的所有污点时，省略 effect 才被认为是可选的。尽管如此，即使在这种场景下，也建议指定 effect。

Working with Pod Topology Spread Constraints使用 Pod 拓扑分布约束

Pod topology spread constraints control how Pods are distributed across your cluster to improve availability, resilience, and resource utilization. They define rules for how Pods of a certain group (typically in the same Deployment) should be spread across topology domains (like zones, nodes, or racks). You can define the Pod topology spread constraint in the Pod API with the attribute spec.topologySpreadConstraints.

Pod 拓扑分布约束控制 Pod 在集群中的分布方式，以提高可用性、韧性和资源利用率。它们定义了特定组（通常在同一个 Deployment 中）的 Pod 应如何分布到拓扑域（如可用区、节点或机架）的规则。你可以在 Pod API 中使用属性 spec.topologySpreadConstraints 定义 Pod 拓扑分布约束。

Assigning a Topology Spread Constraint to a Pod为 Pod 分配拓扑分布约束

Example 14-5 shows an example for a Deployment YAML definition with six replicas of an app and ensures that they are evenly spread across availability zones.

示例 14-5 展示了一个 Deployment YAML 定义示例，其中某应用有 6 个副本，并确保它们均匀分布在各个可用区。

Example 14-5. Assigning a topology spread constraint to a Pod

示例 14-5. 为 Pod 分配拓扑分布约束

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 6
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
— PDF p.214 —
        app: web
    spec:
      topologySpreadConstraints:
      - maxSkew: 1
        topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
        whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
        labelSelector:
          matchLabels:
            app: web
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.27.1
  • The difference in Pod count between zones must not exceed one.各可用区之间的 Pod 数量差不得超过 1。
  • Uses the node label, in this case the reserved label for defining the Pods spread across availability zones.使用节点标签，本例中为用于定义 Pod 跨可用区分布的保留标签。
  • What to do if a spread cannot be satisfied.如果无法满足分布要求时该怎么做。
  • Applies the spread rule only for Pods with the given label(s).仅对具有给定标签的 Pod 应用分布规则。

Topology Spread Constraint Effects at Runtime拓扑分布约束的运行时效果

There are a couple of important facts to mention on how the concept behaves at runtime. Pod topology spread constraints only affect newly-scheduled Pods; they do not rebalance existing Pods. You can define multiple constraints, e.g., a spread by zones and node hostnames. Be aware that the use of the concept can lead to unschedulable Pods if constraints are too strict and resources are limited.

关于该概念在运行时的行为，有几个重要事实需要说明。Pod 拓扑分布约束只影响新调度的 Pod；它们不会重新平衡已存在的 Pod。你可以定义多个约束，例如按可用区分布和按节点主机名分布。请注意，如果约束过严且资源有限，使用该概念可能导致 Pod 无法被调度。

Summary本章小结

Kubernetes Pod scheduling is the process of assigning Pods to available nodes in a cluster based on various criteria. By default, the Kubernetes scheduler considers resource requirements, node availability, and constraints like taints, tolerations, and node selectors.

Kubernetes Pod 调度是根据各种标准把 Pod 分配到集群中可用节点的过程。默认情况下，Kubernetes 调度器会考虑资源需求、节点可用性，以及污点、容忍和 node selector 等约束。

Developers can influence scheduling using node affinity, which expresses preferences for particular node labels, and Pod affinity/anti-affinity, which controls whether Pods are colocated or separated. Taints and tolerations allow nodes to repel certain Pods unless those Pods explicitly tolerate the taint. Topology spread constraints help evenly distribute Pods across failure domains like zones or nodes.

开发者可以使用节点亲和性（表达对特定节点标签的偏好）以及 Pod 亲和性/反亲和性（控制 Pod 是被放置在一起还是被分隔开）来影响调度。污点和容忍允许节点排斥某些 Pod，除非这些 Pod 显式容忍该污点。拓扑分布约束帮助把 Pod 均匀分布到可用区或节点等故障域上。

— PDF p.215 —

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Be able to identify the node a Pod runs on. As an end user to Kubernetes, you can easily find out which node a Pod runs on. Become familiar with the relevant kubectl commands that give you access to this information. During the exam, you may be asked which Pods run on which nodes of the cluster.能够识别 Pod 运行在哪个节点上。作为 Kubernetes 的终端用户，你可以轻松查明 Pod 运行在哪个节点上。熟悉能让你获取该信息的相关 kubectl 命令。考试中可能会问你哪些 Pod 运行在集群的哪些节点上。
  • Understand the ins and outs of Pod scheduling options. You'll need to be familiar with a wide range of Pod scheduling concepts. Tasks in the exam may ask you select the most suitable concept to define soft or hard requirements for specific scheduling scenarios. Most likely, the Pod scheduling concept is spelled out explicitly, and you will need to be able to apply the syntax appropriately.精通 Pod 调度选项的方方面面。你需要熟悉广泛的 Pod 调度概念。考试中的任务可能要求你为特定调度场景选择最合适的概念，以定义软性或硬性需求。很可能题目会明确指出 Pod 调度概念，而你需要能够恰当地应用相应语法。

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的解答见附录 A。

  1. Inspect the existing nodes and their assigned labels. Pick one available node and label it with the key-value pair color=green. Pick a second node and label it with the key-value pair color=red. Define a Pod with the image nginx:1.27.1 in the YAML manifest file pod.yaml. Use the nodeSelector assignment to schedule the Pod on the node with the label color=green. Create the Pod and ensure that the correct node has been used to run the Pod. Change the Pod definition to schedule it on nodes with the label color=green or color=red. Verify that the Pod runs on the correct node.检查现有节点及其被分配的标签。挑选一个可用节点，给它打上键值对 color=green 的标签。再挑选第二个节点，给它打上键值对 color=red 的标签。在 YAML 清单文件 pod.yaml 中定义一个使用镜像 nginx:1.27.1 的 Pod。使用 nodeSelector 分配把该 Pod 调度到标签为 color=green 的节点上。创建该 Pod，并确认使用了正确的节点来运行它。修改 Pod 定义，把它调度到标签为 color=green 或 color=red 的节点上。验证 Pod 运行在正确的节点上。
  2. Define a Pod with the image nginx:1.27.1 in the YAML manifest file pod.yaml. Create the Pod and check which node the Pod is running on. Add a taint to the node. Set it to exclusive=yes. The effect should be NoExecute. Modify the live Pod object by adding the following toleration: it should be equal to the taint key-value pair and have the effect NoExecute. Observe the running behavior of the Pod. If your cluster has more than a single node, where do you expect the Pod to run? Remove the taint from the node. Do you expect the Pod to still run on the node?在 YAML 清单文件 pod.yaml 中定义一个使用镜像 nginx:1.27.1 的 Pod。创建该 Pod，并检查它运行在哪个节点上。给该节点添加一个污点，设置为 exclusive=yes，效果应为 NoExecute。修改在线 Pod 对象，添加如下容忍：它应与污点键值对相等，且效果为 NoExecute。观察 Pod 的运行行为。如果你的集群不止一个节点，你预计 Pod 会运行在哪里？从节点上移除污点。你预计 Pod 还会运行在该节点上吗？
